title: Evaluate selective provider additions
description: Use the quality/cost matrix to decide whether Perplexity (hard date/path/domain filters), SearXNG (explicit self-hosted privacy), Tavily (search/extract), or Anthropic native search fills a real gap. Each candidate needs stable evidence normalization, billing policy, deterministic fixtures, and explicit live smoke before implementation.

logs.msg: Closed the selective-provider evaluation gate. Current shipped portfolio plus explicit official X now covers native, keyword, semantic, objective/context, exact social, and direct page retrieval. Perplexity remains the only conditional addition for a measured hard date/path/domain gap; SearXNG is self-hosted-only; Tavily/Anthropic remain conditional due overlap/auth/cost. No immediate additional adapter.
